newsitem.title: USA: Multiple Zones names DeFeo as CEO.
newsitem.headline: Multiple Zones names DeFeo as CEO.

text.p: Multiple Zones International Inc said Monday it appointed John DeFeo as chief executive officer, president, chief operating officer and vice chairman.
DeFeo, 50, was president and chief executive officer of U.S. West New Vector Group, the domestic cellular communications subsidiary of U S West Communications Group from 1985 to 1994.
Victor Melfi Jr., who had held the position of CEO and President, will continue with the team in his prior position as executive vice president of marketing.
Multiple Zones is a leading global direct marketer of microcomputer hardware, software, peripherals and accessories for users of PC/Wintel and Apple Macintosh-compatible computers.
